summary: TIM S.A. filed a Form 6-K notifying the election of Ms. Luciene Pandolfo as Chief Legal Officer, effective June 17, 2026. The announcement follows a prior notice from March 31, 2026, and was approved by the Company's Board of Directors. Ms. Pandolfo brings over 20 years of legal experience, including roles at Agip Brasil, BR Towers, and CNP Latam. No material terms, compensation, or strategic changes were disclosed. The filing is a routine corporate governance update and does not constitute a special situation. No deal terms or activist involvement are present.
